newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn cattle market steady, light test- USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn cattle market steady, light test- USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were steady in a light test, compared with Wednesday's close, USDA said. Trade slow. Demand moderate to good. Seller interest light to moderate. Offerings current.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1175-1275 lbs 70.50-71.00.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1050-1200 lbs 70.00-71.00.
Carcass Basis (weight only) Compared to Wednesday's close, slaughter steers and heifers were not well tested.

Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1150-1275 lbs few 112.00 Holstein - (weight only) Select to mostly Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs 102.00-103.00 Holstein - (grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs 104.00-105.00 Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs 100.00.
